checklistGeneric: Partner selection evidenced against documented criteria
Due diligence completed before any authority is granted
Selection decision approved and retained on file
checklistSpecific: Confirm the territory requires a locally admitted policy and record the legal basis (compulsory class, non-admitted prohibition, tax rule)
Shortlist candidate local carriers or fronting partners and check each holds a current licence for the class in that territory
Check each candidate financial strength rating, local market reputation and capacity against the programme requirement
Confirm the partner can issue the required local wording, evidence of cover and premium tax handling within the programme timetable
Record the selection rationale, the rejected alternatives and the approval, and open the partner record on the programme file

testing.expected: Selected local partner recorded with licence evidence, rating and selection rationale
No local partner selected without completed licence and financial-strength due diligence
